rawFindings.title: Inconsistent Cloning of themeRoute in ErrorFormatters.html
rawFindings.explanation: In ErrorFormatters.html, the assignment of params.request.themeRoute uses _.clone only if params.request.themeRoute is truthy, else assigns an empty object. This results in the new themeRoute being a shallow clone or an empty object. For safety and code consistency, cloning should always occur if themeRoute exists.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change line 152 to always clone params.request.themeRoute when set: params.request.themeRoute = _.clone(params.request.themeRoute || {});
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If params.request.themeRoute is an object with nested properties and changes to params.request.themeRoute after assignment affect original references due to shallow clone, leading to potential state corruption.

rawFindings.title: Descriptor Freezing and Controller Assignment in RequestHandler._registerRoute
rawFindings.explanation: In _registerRoute, the routeDescriptor.themes[site][theme][method] is assigned descriptor after setting descriptor.controller = Controller, then the whole descriptor is frozen with Object.freeze to prevent modification. This is important to prevent tampering of route definitions at runtime. Previously, descriptor was assigned and then controller was assigned separately, without freezing, which risked modifications.
rawFindings.suggestion: The new approach is correct; ensure that descriptor.controller is set before freezing descriptor and assigning to routeDescriptor.themes to protect integrity of route definitions.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If descriptor.controller was not set before freezing descriptor, or Object.freeze was not applied, code could mistakenly mutate route definitions leading to inconsistent route handling.
